headline: Faster estimators for heritability, Y-haplogroups, and fine-scale ancestry inference
label: Scalable Genomic Analysis Tools
summary: Recent preprints and a published method pair established population-genetic estimators with faster, deployable implementations.
synthesis: The dominant thread is re-engineering established population-genetic estimators for throughput and accessibility. LDscore ports LD score regression to Python 3 and deploys it as a cloud web app in NCI LDlink, adding reference populations for heritability and genetic correlation. FastHer estimates local heritability from GWAS summary statistics and LD matrices via one eigen-decomposition, with accuracy matching HEELS and GREML. Pastrami applies supervised haplotype copying with non-negative least squares to fine-scale ancestry inference and is about 45x faster than ChromoPainter. yallHap adds probabilistic Y-chromosome haplogroup scoring on YFull tree SNPs with ancient DNA damage filtering. The set is heterogeneous: LDscore is primarily infrastructure, whereas FastHer, Pastrami, and yallHap are algorithmic. What is new is the pairing of computational gains with deployable tooling, most explicit in LDscore; Pastrami offers the most quantitative speed benchmark here.
